nina: quick heads-up: found a bundler mismatch when our SDK is dynamically imported from edge workers and uses conditional exports. repro with vite/rollup/webpack.

jordy: can you paste the minimal repro?

nina: package.json exports: { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" } }, type: "module". app does `await import('my-sdk')` inside an edge worker.

lee: error seen?

nina: vite dev -> `TypeError: Cannot set property 'exports' of #<Object>`; webpack prod -> `Module not found: Can't resolve './dist/esm/index.js'` even though file exists.

ci-bot: note: bundlers often pre-resolve dynamic imports and may ignore conditional `exports` qualifiers depending on resolver implementation.

jordy: quick workaround: add a `browser` export pointing to the ESM build: "browser": "./dist/esm/index.js" — fixes vite + rollup + webpack in local tests.

olga: typings issue too: editors can't resolve types if `exports` doesn't expose them. add "./package.json": { "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" } or include `types` at top-level.

lee: long-term: update SDK publish script to emit explicit `browser` + `module` + `types` entries and include a non-conditional `.` fallback to ESM so bundlers don't need to interpret qualifiers. Add CI test that dynamic-imports in an edge worker and builds with webpack/vite/rollup.

nina: i've pushed a tiny repro and three build configs to https://github.com/redwood-inference/repro-edge-imports and added `npm run build:vite|rollup|webpack`. please test and I'll file the docs PR with packaging checklist.

jordy: i'll take webpack tests (adjust resolve.mainFields / conditionNames). lee will take rollup plugin suggestions. olga will write the typings section.

nina: thanks — closing here once PR merges.
